versions.changelog:
- Initial release: Adds a human-in-the-loop review layer for autonomous agents and automated pipelines.
- Routes risky, irreversible, or sensitive actions (e.g., privilege escalation, payments, data deletion) to a manual review queue, preventing unsupervised agent overreach.
- Includes built-in review grading, review queue management (add/pending/approve/reject/summary), and complete audit logging (proposed by/action/risk/reviewer/conclusion/reason/timestamp).
- Integrates with other skills such as safety-guardrails and behavior-observability.
- Provides a built-in learning system that improves efficiency and adapts to user preferences over time.
